notes: 1988 Earthworks

rows.title: Teardrop (Mazaruni Dub One)
notes: 2018 UMC (Universal Music Catalogue)
“Heard from Blank Entourage a couple songs time ago. That's like a Plunderphonics project.”
Sydney plunderphonics/vaporwave project ("everything is plundered") with several 2024–25 releases on Bandcamp; specific track not identified from the announcement.

rows.title: Invisible
notes: 2003 Edit corp

rows.title: Night Wave In Ibiza
notes: “And Nightwave in Ibiza or Ibiza from Sula and Angela.”
the audio briefly looked like Adrian Rover - Just Restart, but the presenter said otherwise
2008 Balearic chillout track from the Café del Mar Vol. 15 (Volumen Quince) compilation.
“Here's another one from Blank Entourage.”
Sydney electronic/beats producer with a large Bandcamp catalogue (incl. 2024 album 'Ode to Our Passing' on egoscapes); specific track not identified from the announcement.

rows.title: Risingson
notes: 1997 Circa
“some Pugilist”

Melbourne bass producer; the station tracklist for this show lists two Pugilist plays, 'Oblivion' and 'Introspect Ft. Tamen', both from the March 2026 album Found Sound (Ruff Kutz) — the quote doesn't say which.

rows.title: Spare Senses
notes: “also heard from Context”
Confirmed by the fbi.radio episode tracklist (00:35:19); 'Context' is a mishearing of Kontext, a St Petersburg producer — track from the 2013 'La Dissidence LP' on 3pbeats Records.

rows.title: Run Time
notes: “and before this Runtime”
7-min ambient/dub cut from the self-titled Digital Mystery Tour album (Stephane Holweck / Total Eclipse, France; originally early 2000s, on Bandcamp since 2020).

rows.title: Technoninja
notes: 2023 SGRA

rows.title: Darkside
notes: “heard from Bunko Degaya before this dark side”
From Deep Live (1992), a cassette-only live recording at Club Dog, London, on Banco de Gaia's own World Bank label.

rows.title: Adrenalin Spaceboy (Dub Boy Extended Mix)
notes: “This is a good one from 99 cents Adrenaline Spaceboy and we're listening to the Dubboy Extended Mix”
1998 Australian dance single on DanceNet (vocals by Kiva); the Dub Boy Extended Mix runs ~10 minutes and is a collector favourite.

rows.title: Introspect
notes: “one from Pugilist and Taman or Taman. It was Introspect. From Pugilist's album Found Sound”
Track 11 on Found Sound (Ruff Kutz, March 2026), the debut solo album by Naarm/Melbourne producer Pugilist, featuring Tamen.

rows.title: Desert Wind
notes: “Heard one from Banco de Gaia, Desert Wind”
1993 single/EP on Planet Dog Records by UK ambient-dub act Banco de Gaia; exists in several mixes (Sunset, El Ahram, Ambient Dub), so the exact version played is unknown.

rows.title: New Age Pension
notes: “also heard from Glamorous Hooligan in there as well”
1996 trip-hop track from the Bradford trio's album Wasted Youth Club Classics, confirmed on FBi's own tracklist for this episode.
“I've heard a couple from X Coast”

Serbian-born, NYC-based house/electro producer; the fbi.radio tracklist for this show lists two X-Coast tracks, 'Sunset' (soundcloud.com/x-coast/sunset) and 'Ghetto Baby' (2016, Steel City Dance Discs — x-coast.bandcamp.com/track/ghetto-baby).
“I've heard a couple from X Coast, who is a Serbian DJ and producer”

Novi Sad-born, Brooklyn-based producer (Bojan Cizmic); FBi's official tracklist for this show lists two X-Coast tracks, 'Sunset' and 'Ghetto Baby' (the latter from Steel City Dance Discs Vol. 3, Sydney label, 2016).

rows.title: Dog Swamp
notes: “This is from Haim DJ I believe from WA. The song's called Dog Swamp.”
Title track of Perth producer Hame DJ's 2018 debut Dog Swamp EP on Vulcan Venti (12" vinyl/digital).

rows.title: Spiral
notes: “And a Rosa Terenzi song, an older one of hers. I think it was called Spiral.”
From her 2020 debut LP Modern Bliss on Planet Euphorique (Australian producer, Melbourne/Perth).

rows.title: The Key
notes: 2000 !K7 Records

rows.title: Dans La Pièce Vide
notes: “Listening to iCube now. Don La Pice Vide.”
Deep, dubby house cut from French producer I:Cube's 1999 album Adore on Versatile Records (Paris).
